text: Two changes break existing behaviour. #12194 makes Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. disable default credentials unless callers opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) on-premises, and #12157 marks the GetAddress.io UK postcode objects obsolete as the service is retired. Security work also includes #12133, which blocks file:// URLs in Web Request Helper, and #11967, which stops Edit in Excel on User table pages. #10755 moves five codeunits to native HttpClient. Fixes cluster in Subscription Billing (#10347, #10210, #11824, #10447, #10156), subcontracting and manufacturing (#12082, #12080, #12068, #11945, #11938, #11644, #11368), Shopify (#11899, #11866, #11854) and regional tax or audit files (#12119, #12008, #12007, #11941, #11907, #11852, #11632, #12134). E-document work covers German SEPA Direct Debit mapping (#8429), service selection (#9642), per-type direction (#11484) and PEPPOL output (#12051, #11968). The Expense Agent gains travel request handling (#12074), policy history (#11628) and approval limits (#11639), and expense configuration writes move to admins (#11996). Power BI deployment now works outside evaluation companies (#12189). Other additions: Fabric export setup (#11314), Payables Agent email cleanup (#11890, #11950), and pre-release NuGet support in AL-Go (#2367). BCQuality added guidance in #210, #207 and #205.
